entities.notes: 21 distinct, live-verified catalog product slugs (Stage 4, 2026-08-21), aggregated across /search?q={cream,toner,mask,serum,set}. Satisfies the 20+ item requirement for TC-009. This is a real staging catalog with NopCommerce sample-data titles suffixed '— Authentic Korean Beauty Wholesale Product with Premium Quality Assurance'; broader searches (e.g. q=korean) surface unrelated demo products (laptops, Adobe Photoshop) that should NOT be used as wishlist fixtures.

preconditions.note: The shared test account's wishlist was verified empty (0 items) both before and after Stage 0/1 exploration — any add performed during exploration was reverted via the Remove action. Empty-state test cases (REQ-04) can rely on this account's default state; populated-state test cases (REQ-03, REQ-05, REQ-06) must add product 63 themselves as a setup step and should not assume pre-existing wishlist contents.
